items.title: If Only America Could Get Out of Its Own Way….
items.summary: The brands lining up to buy a piece of Freddy are going to fail; it shows how little America's pull depends on marketing, and how much it depends on the country getting out of its own way.

items.title: Air India Goes Budget With ‘Basic’ Fare Option
items.summary: Air India's full-service offering has set it apart in a market dominated by low-cost airlines. The new fares blur that line.

items.title: Europe’s New Rules Leave Airlines With the Same €8 Billion Problem
items.summary: For an industry that spent 13 years arguing that passenger rights needed to be watered down, it's a rather bumpy landing.

items.title: Why Chesky Is Building His AI Lab Outside Airbnb
items.summary: The smartest read of Chesky’s AI lab is that he learned the exact lesson of Meta’s metaverse: if you’re going to make a bet the market will punish, don’t make it where the market can see it.

items.title: How Marriott’s Design Hotels Landed an Independent That Once Said No
items.summary: This is the trade independent hotels keep making: a major hotel group’s reach in exchange for a fee and a fight to stay distinctive. Palisociety thinks the math works.

items.title: Marriott Hotel Owners Want a Bigger Cut of Loyalty Income
